name: Keystone Electrical Manufacturing Company
old_description: Since 1964, the Keystone team has fine-tuned its expertise in the design and production of power protection and control equipment. As part of Keystone’s services, we’ll manage your control system manufacturing process and ensure all design requirements are met – precisely and cost-effectively.
about:
Keystone Electrical Manufacturing Company has operated from Des Moines, Iowa since 1964. The company designs and builds power protection and control equipment for the electrical generation, transmission, and distribution sectors.

Its vertically integrated facility handles sheet metal fabrication, assembly, wiring, and testing in-house. The product line includes protection and control panels (line, distribution, transformer, bus differential, annunciator, feeder, metering, communication, SCADA/RTU), substation control centers ranging from 20-by-14-foot to 60-by-30-foot buildings, power distribution centers from 5 kV to 35 kV, medium voltage switchgear up to 38 kV, and low voltage control panels for OEMs. Engineering support services cover detailed bills of material, point-to-point wiring diagrams, AC/DC schematics, and as-built documentation.

Customers include electric utilities, utility-scale wind turbine and transformer manufacturers, voltage regulation system builders, industrial machinery OEMs, and renewable energy integrators. Keystone also works with overseas OEMs serving the U.S. market to meet NEC and UL 508A requirements.

The company cites its single-point project management, documented quality assurance program with in-process and final testing using a Doble F6150e test set, Peschel 100 kV Hi-Pot, and custom breaker simulator, and the option for customer facility inspections as key differentiators.
